title: Prompt Builder (跟著我寫提示詞)
summary: Turn an app or game idea into an AI prompt with Kodi. Answer four questions in your own words, or choose idea cards for features, rules, and style.
summaryZhTW: 跟著 Kodi，把工具或遊戲點子寫成 AI 提示詞。用自己的話回答四個問題，或透過靈感卡挑選功能、規則與風格。
controls: Choose a module, answer questions or select cards, then copy your prompt into an AI chat.
limitations: Module 2 uses external scripts. Read-aloud voices depend on the browser and device.

approval.note: The creator requested the two-module landing page and its publication in Possibility Apps.

coverAlt: Kodi, a bear in glasses and a lab coat, helps a learner choose between a checklist and a game controller at a wooden workbench.
